name: Francisco Assis - § 28 - Am 4
title: REPORT on the financial activities of the European Investment Bank – annual report 2024
part_text: 28. Deplores the EIB’s proactive approach in the area of security and defence; highlights the fact that investment in this sector doubled in 2024 to EUR 1 billion, with the EIB’s 2025 plan set to double it again to a record EUR 2 billion; stresses, in this context, that, in the middle of a social and economic crisis, there is a need for social and environmental investments, rather than an arms race;
